name: player_keeptradecut_value range year_offset averages the offset-window snapshots (executed-result parity)
description: keeptradecut_valuations is date-grained (no year column), so a range year_offset resolves one AS-OF snapshot per offset: the latest observation at or before opening_day(base_year) + k years carrying the metric. Seed a 2023 REG game (so opening_days has a 2023 row), REFRESH the opening_days matview inside the rolled-back transaction, then seed three ktc snapshots for the player: at opening_day+1yr (4000), opening_day+2yr (4160), and an earlier one at opening_day+0 (9999) that each later offset supersedes. Run player_keeptradecut_value with year=[2023] + year_offset=[1,2]. The bespoke main_select_string_year_offset_range must AVG the two resolved snapshots (4080) -- proving it neither collapses to year_offset[0] nor lets the superseded opening-day observation stand in for either offset. The oracle re-derives the AVG via an independent value threshold (< 9000) rather than the date-window logic.
expected_query: select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, (SELECT AVG(offset_value) FROM opening_days od_o CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ((SELECT ktc_o.keeptradecut_value FROM keeptradecut_valuations ktc_o WHERE ktc_o.pid = player.pid AND ktc_o.is_superflex = true AND ktc_o.keeptradecut_value IS NOT NULL AND ktc_o.observed_at <= (date_trunc('day', od_o.opening_day) + interval '1 year') AND ktc_o.observed_at > (date_trunc('day', od_o.opening_day) + interval '1 year' - interval '30 days') ORDER BY ktc_o.observed_at DESC LIMIT 1)), ((SELECT ktc_o.keeptradecut_value FROM keeptradecut_valuations ktc_o WHERE ktc_o.pid = player.pid AND ktc_o.is_superflex = true AND ktc_o.keeptradecut_value IS NOT NULL AND ktc_o.observed_at <= (date_trunc('day', od_o.opening_day) + interval '2 year') AND ktc_o.observed_at > (date_trunc('day', od_o.opening_day) + interval '2 year' - interval '30 days') ORDER BY ktc_o.observed_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AS offsets(offset_value) WHERE od_o.year = 2023) AS "player_keeptradecut_value_0", "player"."primary_position" from "player" where player.primary_position IN ('ZZ') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500

INSERT INTO keeptradecut_valuations (pid, is_superflex, observed_at, keeptradecut_value) SELECT 'TEST-KTC-000907', true, date_trunc('day', opening_day) + interval '1 year', 4000 FROM opening_days WHERE year = 2023

INSERT INTO keeptradecut_valuations (pid, is_superflex, observed_at, keeptradecut_value) SELECT 'TEST-KTC-000907', true, date_trunc('day', opening_day) + interval '2 year', 4160 FROM opening_days WHERE year = 2023
INSERT INTO keeptradecut_valuations (pid, is_superflex, observed_at, keeptradecut_value) SELECT 'TEST-KTC-000907', true, date_trunc('day', opening_day), 9999 FROM opening_days WHERE year = 2023
result_equivalence.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(keeptradecut_value) AS player_keeptradecut_value_0 FROM keeptradecut_valuations WHERE pid = 'TEST-KTC-000907' AND is_superflex = true AND keeptradecut_value < 9000
